purpose: Stress the frozen 12-cell directional Wilson gate under participant dependence, moderator clustering, domain and blocked-mechanism heterogeneity, and outcome-dependent invalidity without selecting a confirmatory sample size.

fixed_design.primary_gate: Every language-by-domain cell has a one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound strictly below 0.10, using valid eligible outcomes only and full-precision integer counts.
fixed_design.minimum_valid_n: Not imposed or selected. Valid counts and Wilson-only outcomes are retained separately.
fixed_design.blocked_allocation: The three blocked mechanisms rotate deterministically by slot and differ in exposure by at most one within language.
fixed_design.sample_size_policy: All four planned-slot candidates are retained; no winner, minimum, or recruitment total is selected.

data_generating_model.danger_model: Gaussian-threshold Bernoulli construction. For slot i, language l, domain d: Z=sqrt(rho_participant) U_li + sqrt(rho_cluster) C_lg(i) + sqrt(1-rho_participant-rho_cluster) epsilon_lid; danger=1[Z < Phi^-1(p_id)]. This preserves each registered marginal p_id while inducing participant and cluster latent correlation.
data_generating_model.cluster_rule: Slots are assigned consecutively to fixed clusters of the registered size within language. English and Japanese are simulated as separate participant samples; no cross-language independence claim is inferred from this convenience.
data_generating_model.invalidity_model: Each generated outcome is retained independently conditional on danger status, with registered safe and dangerous retention probabilities. Outcome-dependent retention is explicitly MNAR and may bias the observed dangerous-error proportion.
data_generating_model.blocked_mechanism_rule: For the first two blocked-primary domains, p_id may depend on the slot's rotated blocked mechanism. The four anchored-primary domains use their registered domain probability.
data_generating_model.numerical_rule: Seed derivation is deterministic from base seed, scenario order, and planned n. Raw counts and bounds, not displayed rounding, determine outcomes.

scenarios.purpose: Within-slot dependence with unchanged cell marginals.
Participant and moderator/site-like clustering without changing marginal truth.
One unacceptable primary cell cannot be compensated by five safer domains.
A pooled blocked-primary cell may pass while one failure mechanism is unacceptable.
Unacceptable truth can look safer when dangerous responses are disproportionately invalid.
Outcome-dependent retention can also make observed risk more conservative.
Mechanism masking, dependence, clustering, and MNAR act together.

scenario_summary: empirical all-12 primary pass rate and Wilson Monte Carlo interval
product-of-marginals projection and union-bound lower projection
false-reassuring rate for unacceptable pooled-domain truth
false-reassuring rate for any unacceptable blocked mechanism
registered_outputs.cell_summary: For every scenario, n, language, and domain retain truth probability, expected valid-sample probability, mean valid count, mean observed and complete-data error proportions, primary/familywise pass rates, Monte Carlo SE, and Wilson Monte Carlo intervals.
registered_outputs.mechanism_summary: For blocked domains retain rotated exposure, complete and valid dangerous counts, expected and observed mechanism-specific error rates, and unacceptable-mechanism flags.
registered_outputs.replicate_audit: Retain compact replicate-level joint indicators and count extrema; do not retain person-like row data because all records are synthetic.
figures: joint pass probability by scenario and planned n
truth-to-observed error distortion and false reassurance under MNAR/mechanism masking

automated_success_gates.identity: Every parent hash matches before execution.
automated_success_gates.registration: Scenario names, order, parameters, n values, replicate count, and seed match this plan exactly.
automated_success_gates.determinism: Repeated execution of a registered small fixture with the same seed is byte-identical at the returned-table level.
automated_success_gates.marginals: No-missing generated complete-data rates are compatible with registered marginals using a prespecified six-standard-error plus 0.002 tolerance.
automated_success_gates.baseline: Independent-safe empirical per-cell pass rates are compatible with exact binomial probabilities using a prespecified six-combined-standard-error plus 0.01 tolerance.
automated_success_gates.retention: Simulated validity and valid-sample dangerous proportions are compatible with their analytic outcome-dependent-retention expectations using the prespecified tolerance.
automated_success_gates.logic: Joint primary pass implies all 12 primary cells pass; familywise joint pass implies primary joint pass; false-reassuring indicators require the corresponding registered truth-risk flag.
automated_success_gates.mechanism: Rotated exposure differs by at most one and mechanism-specific summaries do not alter the frozen pooled primary gate.
automated_success_gates.precision: Every reported Monte Carlo probability includes replicate count, Monte Carlo SE, and a Wilson 95% interval.
automated_success_gates.selection: MinimumValidPerCellRegistered=false, PlannedRecruitmentNSelected=false, HumanParticipants=0, ConfirmatoryResultAvailable=false, and PublicSurfaceEnabled=false.
automated_success_gates.tests: New dependence-stress tests plus the selected confirmatory planning/gate, operations, comprehension, one-click, archive, and decision-stability tests pass.

interpretation_limits.simulation: Results are conditional on eight constructed Gaussian-threshold scenarios and are not empirical estimates of future users, sites, languages, devices, or accessibility strata.
interpretation_limits.correlation: Latent Gaussian rho is not the observed binary ICC and no claim of realistic moderator/site correlation is made.
interpretation_limits.missingness: Registered MNAR mechanisms are stressors, not identified missing-data models; observed-data Wilson intervals cannot correct outcome-dependent invalidity.
interpretation_limits.mechanism: A pooled primary pass does not validate each blocked failure mechanism.
interpretation_limits.equivalence: Identical simulation parameters across languages do not establish language equivalence.
interpretation_limits.selection: The surface cannot select n without defensible externally justified assumptions and a fresh prospective human-study protocol.
interpretation_limits.ethics: No ethics approval, recruitment authorization, or consent is supplied.
